"use strict";
function collatzLength(start) {
  let n = start;
  let steps = 1;
  while (n !== 1) {
    if (n % 2 === 0) {
      n = Math.trunc(n / 2);
    } else {
      n = 3 * n + 1;
    }
    steps = steps + 1;
  }
  return steps;
}
let limit = 10000;
let best = 1;
let bestLength = 1;
{
  let i = 1;
  while (i < limit) {
    let length = collatzLength(i);
    if (length > bestLength) {
      best = i;
      bestLength = length;
    }
    i = i + 1;
  }
}
console.log(best);
console.log(bestLength);
